title: 第四千二百一十三章 鏖战尊者一第四千二百一十二章 瓮中捉鳖
content_zh:
见八雷尊者这般不堪，仅仅打出一击之力就几乎已经失去战斗，这让躲藏在暗中的剑尘和千魂魔尊二人都有些大感意外。
虽说八雷尊者因为与端靖天界二圣之战早已成重伤之躯，境界甚至都有跌落的风险，但好歹也是一位六重天强者。
这种实力，面对已经去掉了千魂魔尊的诸天神阵，纵使依旧无法抵挡，但也不至于这般不堪。
八雷尊者这奄奄一息的姿态，也是让悬浮在穹顶之下的诸天神阵，迟迟没有打出第二次攻击。
但诸天神阵依旧在运转，光辉璀璨，映照天地，那弥漫出的强大威压宛若一位七重天临世。
在阵法的核心之处，仙尊境三重天实力的噬仙妖花正操控诸天神阵阵图，缔结大阵的数万名仙人一身修为之力，皆尽归它调用。
它在密切关注八雷尊者，不敢有丝毫大意，做好了随时打出第二次攻击的准备。
毕竟是一位修为臻至仙尊境六重天的可怕强者，面对如此人物，哪怕是噬仙妖花和千魂魔尊联手，也根本无法力敌。
若是八雷尊者不计后果的拼命，他们甚至还会面临陨落之危。
因此，对付八雷尊者，只有用诸天神阵！
时间在一息一息的流逝，八雷尊者静静的躺在地上依旧没有任何反应。
高空中，诸天神阵光芒滔天，在持续运转，以居高临下的姿态俯视，蓄势待发。
双方谁都没有多余的举动，一时间，在这太初神殿内的第一层空间内，却是陷入了一片诡异的寂静。
“八雷尊者，你好歹也是一位六重天强者，在端靖天界是以一敌二的恐怖存在，不会这么不堪吧，连神阵的一击都受不了。”千魂魔尊的声音在空荡的虚空中传来，他身披一袭黑色长袍悄无声息的出现在百丈之外，目不转睛的盯着躺在地上的八雷尊者，神色一片警惕。
八雷尊者的身躯依旧没有动弹，唯有那充满虚弱的声音断断续续的传出：“不...不愧是...太尊阵法...这诸天神阵...哪怕...哪怕是残缺不全的状态....其威力也依旧...不容小觑......”
说到这里，八雷尊者满是虚弱的叹了口气，有气无力的说道：“只是可惜...当初文都上人和梦秋圣姑二人联手偷袭老夫，逼得老夫不得不施展秘法自斩境界，最终落得元气大伤，实力锐减的后果。否则，今日面对这残缺不全的诸天神阵，也不至于落得如此不堪。”
直至说完这些话，八雷尊者似乎才终于恢复了一些力气，他在猛烈的咳嗽声中，开始动作艰难，无比吃力的抬起了头，慢慢的从地上爬了起来。
的确，就是爬了起来，就如同凡人摔倒在地似得，翻了一个身，面部与肚子贴着地面，然后四肢同时用力爬起来。
这样的姿势出现在一个仙人身上，并且还是一位十分强大的仙人，当真十分罕见。
站直了身躯后，八雷尊者的身躯依旧止不住一阵摇晃，脚步虚浮，就好似一位腿脚不便的暮年老人，一副随时都要摔倒在地的摸样。

他身上的气息虚弱无比，那股属于仙尊境六重天的威压早已荡然无存。
诸天神阵的一击，似乎击穿了八雷尊者的所有抵抗力量。
“桀桀桀桀，那还真的多亏了文都上人和梦秋圣姑了，如果不是他们二人几乎斩去了你半条命，我们要想对付你，哪怕是有诸天神阵也不是一件容易的事。”千魂魔尊笑道。
诸天神阵的确能爆发出仙尊境七重天的恐怖力量，而以八雷尊者巅峰时期的实力，完全能够在一位七重天强者手中支撑几个回合。
因此，要想单凭诸天神阵的两击之力就对付如八雷尊者这样的强者，的确不太现实。
content_en:
Seeing Lord Eight Thunders in such a state of unbearable condition, almost losing the battle with just one blow, this surprised both Jian Chen and Lord Qianhun Demon who were hiding in the dark.
Although Lord Ba Lei has been seriously injured due to the battle with the two saints of Duanjing Heaven Realm, and his realm is even at risk of falling, he is still a strong man in the sixth heaven realm.
With this kind of strength, even if it is still unstoppable in the face of the All-Heaven Divine Formation that has removed the Thousand Soul Demon Lord, it is not so unbearable.
The dying posture of Lord Ba Lei also prevented the formation of gods suspended under the dome from launching a second attack.
But the formation of the gods is still in operation, its radiance is bright, reflecting the heaven and earth, and the powerful pressure that permeates the world is like a seventh-level heaven coming to the world.
At the core of the formation, the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower with the third-level strength of the Immortal Realm is controlling the formations of all the gods, and all the cultivation power of the tens of thousands of immortals who have formed the formation are controlled by it.
It was paying close attention to Lord Ba Lei, not daring to be careless at all, and was ready to launch a second attack at any time.
After all, he is a terrifying and powerful man who has reached the sixth level of the Immortal Realm. Facing such a person, even if the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower and the Thousand Soul Demon Lord join forces, they are simply unable to defeat him.
If Lord Eight Thunders were to fight regardless of the consequences, they would even be in danger of falling.
Therefore, the only way to deal with the Eight Thunder Lords is to use the Array of All Heavens Gods!
Time passed by breath by breath, and Lord Ba Lei lay quietly on the ground, still without any reaction.
High in the sky, the gods of the heavens were shining brightly, continuing to move, looking down from a high position, ready to go.
No one on either side made any unnecessary moves. For a moment, the first level of space in the Taichu Temple fell into a strange silence.
"Venerable Eight Thunders, after all, you are also a sixth-level powerhouse. In the Duanjing Heaven Realm, you are the terror of one against two. You can't be so unbearable. You can't even withstand a blow from the divine formation." The voice of the Thousand Soul Demon Lord came in the empty void. He appeared quietly a hundred feet away wearing a black robe, staring at the Eight Thunder Lords lying on the ground with a vigilant expression.
The body of Lord Ba Lei still did not move, and only the voice full of weakness came out intermittently: "It is... worthy of... Tai Zun's formation... this gods formation... even... even if it is in a incomplete state... its power is still... cannot be underestimated..."
Having said this, Lord Ba Lei sighed weakly and said weakly: "It's just a pity... Master Wendu and Saint Mengqiu jointly attacked me, forcing me to use secret methods to kill myself. In the end, my vitality was severely injured and my strength was sharply reduced. Otherwise, facing this incomplete divine formation of the gods today, I wouldn't have been in such a miserable state."
After saying these words, Lord Ba Lei seemed to have finally regained some strength. Amidst the violent coughing, he began to move with difficulty, raised his head with great difficulty, and slowly got up from the ground.
Indeed, he just climbed up, just like a mortal who fell to the ground, turned over, put his face and belly on the ground, and then climbed up with all four limbs at the same time.
It is really rare for such a posture to appear on an immortal, and he is also a very powerful immortal.
After standing up straight, Lord Ba Lei's body still couldn't stop swaying, and his steps were sloppy, just like an old man with inconvenient legs and feet, looking like he was about to fall to the ground at any time.
The aura on his body was extremely weak, and the pressure belonging to the sixth level of the Immortal Realm had long since disappeared.
The attack from the Divine Array seemed to have penetrated all the resistance of the Eight Thunder Lords.
"Jie Jie Jie Jie, that's all thanks to Master Wendu and Saint Mengqiu. If they hadn't almost killed half of your life, if we wanted to deal with you, we wouldn't even have the array of gods in the sky.is an easy thing. " Qianhun Demon Lord smiled.
The Divine Array of All Heavens can indeed emit the terrifying power of the Seventh Heaven Immortal Realm, and with the strength of the Eighth Thunder Lord at his peak, he can fully sustain it for several rounds in the hands of a Seventh Heavenly Power.
Therefore, it is indeed unrealistic to deal with a strong person like the Eight Thunder Masters with just two strikes from the Divine Array.
